decision: one mutation gate per package, not one at the repo root
why: a survivor must name the package that owns it and a package can be fixed alone

decision: moved every check into nix flake check
why: the operator asked for one command and no scripts directory

decision: replaced hand-written parsers with decoder combinators
why: each decode reads as one rule and the branches became observable

decision: reused the protocol decoders for provider payloads
why: a malformed body becomes a 400 with the same rule the agent side uses

decision: made the thread index a Durable Object of its own
why: two webhooks for one thread can land on different session objects and must still agree

decision: acknowledged a delivery before the agent starts
why: a provider retries while a turn is still running

decision: kept one ActiveTurn object instead of two id fields
why: two fields could drift apart and the guard had an unreachable branch

decision: drove the real scripted agent over real stdio
why: the codec, supervisor, and bridge are only proved together

decision: accepted four equivalent mutants with a written reason
why: an infinite loop body swap and a fire-and-forget kill have no observable difference

decision: accepted three equivalent mutants in the disk reader
why: a missing encoding name still parses as JSON and an empty catch falls through to the same undefined
